name: Oderzhimaja Remastered
source:
Ah, those yandere girls… The kind who become so obsessed with you that they’re willing to do anything - kill anyone, even you yourself - just to be with you. At first, that kind of devotion can almost feel flattering… But once they start to truly lose their sanity, you begin to regret ever meeting them. And the protagonist of this mod is about to encounter one such yandere.

The story follows a 19-year-old named Artyom, who has grown completely disillusioned with a life full of failures and emotional pain. Falling into deep depression, he shuts himself off from society and finds meaning only in the visual novel "Everlasting Summer" which became his one small ray of light in the endless darkness.

One fateful night, his old friend Mikhail calls him and barely manages to convince him to join another one of his reckless adventures - a trip into the forest. And there, under mysterious circumstances, they both find themselves in "Sovyonok".

At first, everything seems exactly like in the game - idyllic, peaceful, harmonious… But that doesn’t last long. Soon, more and more strange things begin to happen, tearing apart the very essence of the cheerful, carefree camp we know from so many mods. And the strangest thing of all - Miku. There’s clearly something wrong with her… But what exactly?

This is a remake of [url=/v59881]Oderzhimaja[/url], which rewrites the script, improves graphics and sound, and, most importantly, adds tons of additional plot content in place of the original's ending, which will likely lead to a different ending entirely.
